youtube_description:
The Wire: At King of Pro-Wrestling 2018, Switchblade Jay White cemented his betrayal of Okada by teaming up with the Bullet Club OGs. He rejected the offer from Kenny Omega back in January, but Tama Tonga and the rest of the BCOGs made him an offer he couldn't refuse.
